messages.author: 9e7dbb7074ed8037
messages.subject: Shiny server permissions
parts:
Dear All,

I am getting a problem with shiny permissions in my server. I created an landing page with jekyll that gets deployed using travis_ci. I changes the shiny config to run as the user deploy (which travis uses to deploy the files) and changes owernship of /srv/shiny-server to a group which included both shiny and deploy. Since that did not work, I changed the shiny-server config to host apps in the home dir of deploy, and to run as deploy (hoping that that will never cause permission issues). But shiny apps still fail to load, with the apps failing due to permission denied. 

My shiny-config is as below;

# Instruct Shiny Server to run applications as the user "deploy"
run_as deploy;

# Define a server that listens on port 3838
server {
  listen 3838;

  # Define a location at the base URL
  location / {
    run_as deploy;

    # Host the directory of Shiny Apps stored in this directory
    site_dir /home/deploy/shiny-server;

    # Log all Shiny output to files in this directory
    log_dir /var/log/shiny-server;

    # When a user visits the base URL rather than a particular application,
    # an index of the applications available in this directory will be shown.
    directory_index on;
  }
}


And the permissions for shiny-server dir;

total 224
drwxrwsr-x 6 deploy deploy   4096 Sep  8 11:40 .
drwxr-xr-x 9 deploy deploy   4096 Sep  8 11:34 ..
drwxrwxr-x 5 deploy deploy   4096 Sep  8 11:40 assets
drwxrwxr-x 3 deploy deploy   4096 Sep  8 11:40 demo
-rw-rw-r-- 1 deploy deploy     79 Sep  8 11:40 Gemfile
-rw-rw-r-- 1 deploy deploy   1707 Sep  8 11:40 Gemfile.lock
-rw-rw-r-- 1 deploy deploy   1911 Sep  8 11:40 gulpfile.js
-rw-rw-r-- 1 deploy deploy   4648 Sep  8 11:40 index.html
-rw-rw-r-- 1 deploy deploy   1083 Sep  8 11:40 LICENSE.txt
-rw-rw-r-- 1 deploy deploy  37382 Sep  8 11:40 particle.jpg
-rw-rw-r-- 1 deploy deploy     93 Sep  8 11:40 README.md
drwxrwxr-x 4 deploy deploy   4096 Sep  8 11:40 RiskCalculator
-rw-rw-r-- 1 deploy deploy 132177 Sep  8 11:40 yarn.lock
drwxrwxr-x 3 deploy deploy   4096 Sep  8 11:40 zopfli


Could you help?

Thanks loads!

Dev

messages.author: dffc6a7bac21c542
messages.subject: Re: Shiny server permissions
parts:
Hi,

I have struggled with similar access problems. I sorted out them with chmod 0755 <list of files>. Before that, Shiny did not have access to necessary files.

I don't know if this resolves your problem but I hope so.

BR, Pekka
